xero.create_bank_transaction.title: Create Bank Transaction
xero.create_bank_transaction.description: Create a spent or received money transaction in Xero. Use SPEND for payments out or RECEIVE for money received.

tenant_id.description: Xero tenant/organisation ID (UUID). Required so requests cannot silently hit another connected organisation.

ContactID.description: Xero Contact ID for the transaction.

AccountCode.description: Account code this line posts to.

TaxType.description: Tax type code from the organisation's tax rates.

LineItemID.description: Existing line item UUID when updating.

LineItems.description: Line items for the bank transaction.

BankAccountID.description: Bank account UUID. Provide BankAccountID or BankAccountCode.

BankAccountCode.description: Short bank account code, max 10 characters.

xero.create_contact.title: Create Contact
xero.create_contact.description: Create a customer or supplier contact in Xero.

tenant_id.description: Xero tenant/organisation ID (UUID). Required so requests cannot silently hit another connected organisation.

Name.description: Full name of the contact or organisation.

FirstName.description: First name of the contact person.

LastName.description: Last name of the contact person.

AccountNumber.description: Account reference number for the contact.

BankAccountDetails.description: Bank account details for the contact.

PhoneType.description: Phone type, e.g. DEFAULT or MOBILE.

Phones.description: Phone numbers. Use PhoneType DEFAULT or MOBILE.

xero.create_credit_note.title: Create Credit Note
xero.create_credit_note.description: Create an accounts receivable (ACCRECCREDIT) or accounts payable (ACCPAYCREDIT) credit note.

tenant_id.description: Xero tenant/organisation ID (UUID). Required so requests cannot silently hit another connected organisation.

ContactID.description: Xero Contact ID (UUID). Provide ContactID or ContactName.

ContactName.description: Contact name when ContactID is not provided.

AccountCode.description: Account code this line posts to.

TaxType.description: Tax type code from the organisation's tax rates.

LineItemID.description: Existing line item UUID when updating.

LineItems.description: Line items for the credit note.

CreditNoteNumber.description: Credit note number. Omit to let Xero allocate the next number.

SentToContact.description: Mark AUTHORISED credit notes as sent.

xero.create_invoice.title: Create Invoice
xero.create_invoice.description: Create a sales invoice (ACCREC) or bill (ACCPAY). Omit InvoiceNumber so Xero cannot update an existing invoice by number collision.

tenant_id.description: Xero tenant/organisation ID (UUID). Required so requests cannot silently hit another connected organisation.

ContactID.description: Xero Contact ID (UUID). Provide ContactID or ContactName.

ContactName.description: Contact name when ContactID is not provided.

AccountCode.description: Account code this line posts to.

TaxType.description: Tax type code from the organisation's tax rates.

LineItemID.description: Existing line item UUID when updating.

InvoiceNumber.description: Invoice number. Omit to create a new invoice with the next number.

xero.create_item.title: Create Item
xero.create_item.description: Create an inventory item that can be sold and/or purchased.

tenant_id.description: Xero tenant/organisation ID (UUID). Required so requests cannot silently hit another connected organisation.

IsSold.description: Item can be sold when true.

IsPurchased.description: Item can be purchased when true.

xero.create_manual_journal.title: Create Manual Journal
xero.create_manual_journal.description: Create a manual journal. Journal lines must balance (debits equal credits).

tenant_id.description: Xero tenant/organisation ID (UUID). Required so requests cannot silently hit another connected organisation.

LineAmount.description: Signed line amount. Manual journals must balance.

AccountCode.description: Account code this line posts to.

Status.description: DRAFT or POSTED. Defaults to DRAFT.

LineAmountTypes.description: How tax is calculated on line amounts.

ShowOnCashBasisReports.description: Include on cash basis reports. Defaults to true.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key sent as the Idempotency-Key header.

summarize_errors.description: Return summarised validation errors when true.

xero.create_payment.title: Create Payment

xero.create_quote.title: Create Quote
